name.zh: 暗黑武斗场 暗黑第七门 莫尔加斯

location.zh: 精灵太空站 暗黑武斗场 暗黑第七门

reward_note: Each door boss, when beaten, gave its 暗黑精灵's 精元 (4399 2010-06-04: 通关后获得精元), hatching the line's first stage.

capture.zh: 暗黑武斗场暗黑第七门：100级莫尔加斯，约2000血。打败获得莫尔加斯精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 消除强化后，用丽莎布布花草能量+金光绿叶秒杀；或先寄生种子再大招。

engine_notes: Entry (original): 超能NoNo owners loaded the 反物质芯片 directly; others needed NoNo AI level 10 and a crafted 反物质芯片 (VIP-gated). Doors open in order: 试炼之门, then 暗黑第一门 … 第九门 (pre-2013). The remake drops the VIP gate.
All skills ground-type with side effects; high special attack.
Innate boost (天生强化), stat and size not stated: atk+2, as unstated innate boosts are atk+2 (user decision 2026-10-19).

An attack right after the player's previous move on it, if that was also an attack, deals a tenth of its damage; a status move in between restores full damage (百科 暗黑武斗场: 连续第二次对其攻击，伤害只有第一次的十分之一; player comment 三: 使用属性技，再次攻击伤害还是高伤害). Not stated, simplest reading: every attack right after an attack is reduced (the third in a row too); only the moves the player uses count, so a switch, an item or a turn in which the player's monster could not act neither breaks nor extends the chain, and a missed attack extends it; the tenth applies to the attack's damage (not to fixed or percentage damage its effects add), rounded down.
source_note: 4399 第七门攻略: No.441 地面系 Lv100 HP2000.
